source: can you make me a slip and slide game were the longer you slide the more points you get and you can buy pets to help you speed multiplier and there a treadmills to train your speed and make it 1m studs is the end of the track then you go back to the start of the slip and slide and get 1 lap on your character that is on the top of the screen to show your progress and make furthest stud leader board,most money leader board and most playtime leader board with a popular thumbnail of a bacon sliding on a slip in slide covered in soap with rainbow text saying 999m studs

image_prompt.text: Distance increments running the length of the slide so a slider can see how many studs they have covered
Fall-away edges either side of the slide punishing anyone who comes off it
The end of the track at one million studs, where the run terminates and the slider is sent back to the start
A storefront beside the start where pets that multiply sliding speed are bought
Treadmill stations lined up beside the slide where players train their speed
A long slip and slide, soaped and wet along its whole length, running from the start out to the far end

layout_placement.text: Detection at the exact end of the track that returns the player to the start
Lap detection at the end of the run, adding one lap to the player and their furthest-stud total
Recovery points restoring a slider who falls off the track
Treadmill stations as a repeatable speed-training loop
Continuous scoring that pays out the longer a slide is sustained

notes: One million studs is roughly two thousand times the largest scale band and cannot be framed in a single top-down image. Either the number is figurative or the track has to be built as a repeating segment; nothing in the handoff can carry that decision.
Racing owns the shape because the map is a track with an end and a lap count; the loop around it - pets, training, money - is Simulation, loaded only for those two options.
Racing note says no lap and no finish means Simulation, and this prompt has both, which is what settled dominance.

open_questions.ask: Is one million studs literal? At walk speed that is over seventeen hours of track - should it be a repeating segment instead?
What does the slide sit in - a water park, a grass field, a neon void?

coverage_missing.ask: Is the one million studs a real length or a headline number?
Do laps unlock anything, or are they only a counter?

answers.ask: Is one million studs literal? At walk speed that is over seventeen hours of track - should it be a repeating segment instead?
answers.answer: Make it a repeating segmented track with progress measured up to 1,000,000 studs, so it stays playable while still showing the 1m-stud goal.

answers.ask: What does the slide sit in - a water park, a grass field, a neon void?
answers.answer: Set the slip and slide in a bright cartoon water park with grass around it, soap, and colorful rainbow visuals.
